---
description: This prompt helps the user create a SMART goal and adds it to the goals.md file.
agent: Goal Setter
model: GPT-5 mini
---

I have a rough idea for a goal. Please help me refine it into a **SMART** goal (Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, Time-bound). Ask me clarifying questions if necessary, and once we agree on the formulation, save it to my goals file using the standard template.
